title: Miley Cyrus Signs With Atlantic Records
summary: The move sees Cyrus joining Warner Music after 13 years spent under the Sony umbrella.
contentText:
Miley Cyrus has signed with Atlantic Records, representatives confirmed to Billboard . The singer was previously with Columbia Records, on which she released her 2022 live album Attention: Miley Live and 2023’s Endless Summer Vacation and 2025’s Something Beautiful . Summer Vacation included her hit single “Flowers,” which hit No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 for eight weeks and earned her two Grammys: record of the year and best pop solo performance.

The jump to Atlantic marks Cyrus’ move away from Sony Music — where she first signed to RCA Records in 2013 following her departure from Disney’s Hollywood Records — to Warner Music Group. The news was first reported by Variety .

Over her career, Cyrus has enjoyed 13 top 10 hits on the Billboard Hot 100, including two No. 1s: “Flowers” and “Wrecking Ball,” the latter in 2013. She also has five No. 1 hits on the Billboard 200, including three Hannah Montana soundtracks, 2008’s Breakout and 2013’s Bangerz . Something Beautiful , her most recent album, peaked at No. 4 on the chart.

In May, Cyrus received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, with Anya Taylor-Joy and Donatella Versace both speaking at the ceremony. In March, the singer celebrated the 20th anniversary of the Disney series Hannah Montana , with a premiere at the El Capitan Theatre in downtown Hollywood. She also curated the new issue of Wonderland magazine, which is available for purchase in retail stores on Monday (July 27). The magazine also includes Dolly Parton, Darryl Hannah, Noah Cyrus, Lykke Li and Phantogram.
